facts.fact: The Loopy Loyalty pricing page was published on 6 November 2026.
The Starter plan costs $25 per month when billed monthly.
The Starter plan costs $250 per year when billed annually.
The Growth plan costs $69 per month when billed monthly.
The Growth plan costs $690 per year when billed annually.
The Ultimate plan costs $95 per month when billed monthly.
The Ultimate plan costs $950 per year when billed annually.
The vendor states that annual billing saves 20% compared with monthly billing.
The Starter plan includes 1 card design, 1 location, and 3 sub-users.
The Growth plan includes 3 card designs, 3 locations, and 10 sub-users.
The Ultimate plan includes 10 card designs, 10 locations, and 50 sub-users.
The Ultimate plan lists 10 locations as its maximum supported locations.
facts.quote: | Maximum Locations Supported | 1 Location | 3 Locations | 10 Locations |

facts.fact: The vendor offers a free trial of 15 days, and cancelling within the trial means the card is not charged.
facts.quote: Try Loopy Loyalty free for 15 days. If you cancel within the trial, your card will not be charged.

facts.fact: The vendor states it does not offer refunds for subscriptions or renewal charges.
facts.quote: No. Loopy Loyalty does not offer refunds for subscriptions or renewal charges.

facts.fact: The vendor states that after a subscription is cancelled, the account and its loyalty cards are scheduled for deletion after the billing period ends.
facts.quote: scheduled for deletion after your billing period ends

facts.fact: The vendor states that downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle, while upgrades take effect immediately.
facts.quote: downgrades apply at the start of your next billing cycle

facts.fact: The vendor states that signing up does not require a credit card; a card is only required when a draft project becomes an active live project.
facts.quote: A credit card is only required when you move a draft project into an active, live project

facts.fact: The Stamper App user limits are up to 3 users on Starter, up to 10 on Growth, and up to 50 on Ultimate.
facts.quote: | Number of Stamper App Users | Up to 3 | Up to 10 | Up to 50 |
